notes.title: Making Our First-Ever Quill Plushie - Pre-Orders Live Now!
notes.content:
Hello! 

It’s a special time of year for us at Polyarc—the anniversary of Moss! This marks [b]7 years(?!?)[/b] since Quill’s journey began. Can you believe it’s been that long since we first set out on this adventure? Moss has always been about connection, and we're beyond grateful for the love and support that has kept the bond with Quill strong.

This year, we’re making a long-time dream come true… the first-ever official Quill plushie! 🐭💚 

For years, our community has asked for a way to bring Quill home, and honestly? SAME. But as a small studio, finding a way to make it happen was always a challenge—until now. Thanks to Makeship, we finally have a chance to turn this dream into reality.

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32936350/9a9992b0d54d23daa653f77b3add8f35e9ca7e39.png[/img][/url]

[h1]🐤Pre-Order Now for Early Bird Perks[/h1]
The Quill plushie will only go into production if we reach our goal of at least 200 pledges during this limited 7-day campaign. A $2 refundable pledge secures your spot and helps us bring Quill to life! We also have some compelling perks for our early bird pre-orders. 

✅ [b]Exclusive Discord role[/b] – Behind-the-scenes access + vote on key design details
✅ [b]First 200 pre-orders [/b]get a digital code for the Moss Original Soundtrack! 

For more details, [url=https://www.polyarcgames.com/news/7-years-of-moss-makeship-quill-plushie-bring-quill-home]check out our blog post and FAQ [/url]explaining the Makeship plushie process. 

Become an early bird and pre-order now: 
[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie]https://www.makeship.com/petitions/quill-plushie [/url]

You can also help us make this dream a reality is by sharing this with your friends, family and VR spaces to let folks know it’s time to bring Quill home.

notes.title: Recent Patch Summary
notes.content:
There have been a couple of patches following our latest big update to Moss. Here are the details:
[list]
[*] Last week's update was a full rebuild in Unreal 4.27. This was the reason for the large download size.
[*] In the time since the last Steam release, the game's project was renamed from "MossGame" to "Moss". The patch on Oct 19 included an engine change to force it to continue using the name "MossGame" when looking for save data. Save files which appeared to be deleted were not removed and are now visible again by the game. For those who may have started a new game before the Oct 19 name fix, that save data is located in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Moss\Saved\SaveGames and can be transferred to %LOCALAPPDATA%\MossGame\Saved\SaveGames. It is recommended to make a backup of the destination folder before replacing any files.
[*] Old configuration values, in particular those related to input, were getting stuck in cached engine configs. The most recent patch contains a small update to input configs and the default launch option now includes the "-regenerateinis" command line to force the engine to update these cached configs.
[/list]
Thank you to everyone flagging issues and sharing workarounds in the discussion boards.

notes.title: Moss + Free Soundtrack Update
notes.content:
As a special thank you to fans, Polyarc is gifting the full Moss digital soundtrack to everyone who has purchased Moss by 8/17/2018. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936350/f3e565702fb7bb276300789052b4522e422a0896.jpg[/img]

Composed by two-time BAFTA award-winning composer Jason Graves, the soundtrack brings to life the melodic and playful adventure in Moss from the hero Quill’s perspective. Graves accomplishes this by employing small and intimate-sounding instruments composed, arranged, and produced in a pastoral soundscape with enchanting Waltz-esque flair. 

The soundtrack consists of 11 in-game tracks with more than 57 minutes of music, including the bonus track “Home To Me,” featuring YouTube sensation Malukah. 

Starting August 17, 2018, Polyarc will offer a Moss game + Moss Soundtrack bundle for $34.99. 

Here’s how players who purchase Moss through August 17, 2018 can download the soundtrack for free: 
Players will find the soundtrack in the DLC section of Moss as part of the game update hitting August 3, 2018. Everyone has until August 17, 2018 to download the MP3 files before the soundtrack is removed from the DLC section of the single game purchase. 

Thank you and enjoy the music!

notes.title: Moss 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
Moss now officially supports Windows Mixed Reality headsets! We’ve also added a new Controls sub-menu which can be found within the Pause Menu. This sub-menu will allow you to reference your current controller layout as well as toggle between two new layouts.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936350/95964c931733e8900e21725709505351e73876d9.png[/img]

The first layout option allows you to change the way movement controls. You can select between Touch-to-Move and Press-to-Move. The former is the layout we shipped Moss with. The latter requires you to press and hold as you move Quill through the environment. We’ve found this helps mitigate a handful of the ghost input issues players have been reporting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936350/ee61eff33a43de453783d1fa583a640ad675108a.png[/img]

The second layout option allows you to change the way your Jump and Attack actions are mapped. You can select between the Default layout of Attack/Jump on either side of the touch-pad or Dedicated Jump. The Dedicated Jump layout assigns Attack to the right-hand top menu button and utilizes the full touch-pad surface for Jump.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32936350/94089375272999f821e2a26a323c0bf5e0eae4ac.png[/img]

Both options are intended to alleviate issues players have been reported with the Vive wand touch pad. If you are one of the players that has had issues with the controls in Moss we’d love to hear any feedback you may have after trying them out.

In addition to these changes we’ve made a few quality of life fixes. Any action that potentially affects Save Data will provide context to what the action specifically does. We’ve also fixed the Spectator Screen to open at an appropriate window size. Lastly, we've made optimizations to how levels reload when respawning. Reload times are faster in these situations.

notes.title: Moss 1.0.2 Hotfixes
notes.content:
We have pushed two updates (one yesterday, another today) to address some specific issues we've seen. The most important of these is an improvement to the responsiveness for climbing. The controls for climbing up or down are as follows:

The jump button (right hemi-circle of the right hand trackpad on Vive) is used both to climb up and climb down. The way that you indicate a climb down is to provide move input away (left trackpad on Vive) from the ledge and press jump. This should tell Quill to jump down.

And here are the patch notes!

1.0.1
[list]
[*] Resolved issue where under some circumstances music would stop playing when returning from the system menu
[/list]
1.0.2
[list]
[*] Improved input consistency for Quill climbing up or down ledges
[/list]
